'''Aegis Squadron''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]]-equipped squadron of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. In [[3636 BBY]] former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] came to Ziost and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to murder civilians. Pilots of Aegis Squadron were among those who fell under his control and their walkers were used to wreak destruction in the area around [[New Adasta]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aegis Squadron Walkers were added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2. Destroying all walkers is required to obtain an achievement.
